items.title: iii (formerly Motia)
items.summary: Tiny open-core Rust agent/workflow engine (~18.9k stars); no public funding found, legal entity unclear.

items.title: LaunchDarkly
items.summary: Feature management leader, $200M+ ARR, private since a 2021 $3B Series D; betting on AgentControl for AI agents. Background notes only.

items.title: Parasail
items.summary: Pay-per-token inference cloud for AI startups; Series A ($42M raised), ~25-45 staff, San Mateo; risk: crowded price war, thin capital for an owned GPU fleet

items.title: Resolve AI
items.summary: AI SRE ('AI for prod') from the ex-Splunk Observability founders; Series A at $1.5B, $190M+ raised, ~166 people (~70 eng); headcount flat for 6 months, valuation far ahead of ~$4M reported ARR.
